"Her Majesty" | | | | +-----------------------------------------------------------------------+ | | +---------------------------------------------------------------------------+-----------------------------------+ "Her Majesty" is a song written by Paul McCartney (although credited to Lennon-McCartney) that appears on the Beatles' album Abbey Road. It is a brief tongue-in-cheek music hall song. "Her Majesty" is the final track of the album and appears fourteen seconds after the song "The End", but was not listed on the original sleeve. As such, it is considered one of the first examples of a hidden track in rock music. ©1969 Sony/ATV Music Publishing LLC. All rights reserved. Used by permission.
